episodes.166924: Clusters of thunderstorms developed across the Atlantic coastal waters ahead of a strong cold front. These thunderstorms produced strong wind gust.
episodes.167141: A cold front crossed the area with strong thunderstorms that produced gusty winds.
episodes.167395: Showers with some embedded thunderstorms resulted in isolated flooding in Montgomery County in eastern New York on March 19, 2022.
episodes.167540: A strong upper-level low pressure system produced gusty winds across the mountains and desert slopes and widespread light rainfall March 19-20, 2022.
episodes.167656: A line of showers and thunderstorms moved through South Florida during the late afternoon and early evening ahead of an approaching cold front. Some of the storms contained gusty winds and hail, primarily over interior sections of the peninsula.
episodes.167711: An elongated trough moving through the western CONUS produced scattered showers and isolated thunderstorms across the region during the afternoon of the 20th. According to the Scottsdale Fire Department, lightning struck a palm tree and also resulted in significant damage to the electrical system of a home. No injuries were reported.
episodes.168118: Conditions were favorable for the development of multiple cumulus cloud lines around the Lower, Middle and Upper Florida Keys.  Several waterspouts were observed.

events.narrative: Montgomery County Sheriff reported minor flooding on roadways due to nearby creeks overflowing their banks. This included Millers Corners Road near Mill Point and Logtown Road near the town of Glen.

A crash occurred around 1 AM in the University City area of San Diego. Just before the crash at 12:55 AM, the Miramar MCAS ASOS KNKX (2-3 SM NE of crash) reported light rain and mist with a visibility of 2.5 miles. Light rain turned heavier after 1 AM with reduced visibility as low as 1.5 miles. All southbound lanes of I-805 were shut down from 1 AM - 8 AM, when two lanes were reopened to southbound drivers. Driver appeared to avoid serious injury but the truck burst into flames and firefighters were dispatched.

events.county: Straits Of Florida From West End Of Seven Mile Bridge To South Of Halfmoon Shoal Out 20 Nm
events.narrative: A waterspout was observed via NWS rooftop cameras and the duty weather observer at Naval Air Station Key West Boca Chica Field, approximately 9 miles south of Key West.  The condensation cloud extended about halfway from the cloud base to the surface and was generally vertical.  No spray ring was observed.

events.county: Straits Of Florida From West End Of Seven Mile Bridge To South Of Halfmoon Shoal Out 20 Nm
events.narrative: A waterspout was observed and reported via social media that was visible from Big Pine Shoal.  It was reportedly narrow and extended three quarters of the way down from cloud base.  No spray ring was observed.

events.county: Bayside And Gulfside From Craig Key To West End Of Seven Mile Bridge
events.narrative: Two waterspouts were observed north of Long Key.  One waterspout had a visible spray ring, with its medium-sized condensation cloud nearly vertical and extending three-quarters of the way from cloud base.  The waterspouts moved toward the southwest at an estimated 5 to 10 mph.

According to the Scottsdale Fire Department, lightning struck a palm tree very close to a home near 102nd Street and Mountain View Road in Scottsdale, which ended up sustaining significant damage to its electrical system. No injuries were reported. Timing estimated from radar.
An off duty NWS meteorologist reported quarter size hail from a thunderstorm along Tamiami Trail/US 41 in 40 Mile Bend in far western Miami-Dade County.
